limitations: Discrete local leg samples do not establish continuous clearance or full robot clearance.
Connector proxies are provisional envelopes and do not reproduce flexible cable behavior.
The blind connector pocket leaves about 1.6 mm of material; fit and loaded strength require physical tests.
Printed tolerances, loaded deflection, retainer seating and servo thermal behavior remain physical checks.
Tool envelopes establish access only for their specified dimensions and approach directions.

motion.scope: Twenty-seven local leg poses; same-link pairs are excluded from motion checking

connector_reserves.scope: Three critical poses at yaw zero; each proxy is checked against every part except its owning servo
connector_reserves.limitation: The proxy is a provisional plugged-profile and wire reserve, not a measured cable sweep

clamp_access.scope: Nine clamp screw and tool paths in one complete local leg at one assembly pose.
limitations: Results apply to this pose and these explicit proxy dimensions only.
All supplied physical solids are tested, including servo cases, horns and discs; none is exempted for sharing a link.
Current leg geometry does not include clamp fasteners or central retainers. Their real dimensions and seating need confirmation.
The screw assumes a bare seated M3 x 35 cap head. Washers, a different head, nut or screw length change the envelopes.
The nut insertion starts at raw Y=-25 mm, matching the opened access passage; initial nut positioning outside that entry is not swept.
The matched hex envelope allows normal captive-nut flats. It does not prove printed fit or resistance to nut rotation under tightening.
The hollow nut holder clears a projecting screw but is an assumed aid; it does not establish how a real tool holds the nut.
The driver checks a straight exposed shaft at the seated head. Driver handles, hand clearance and the whole driver insertion motion are absent.
The local leg test omits the body, neighboring legs, ground, flexible wiring and unmodeled connectors.
Touching surfaces and positive intersections below the reporting threshold are retained in the report and require interpretation.
No blocking volume above threshold is not a physical access verification or a tolerance allowance.

retention.retention_logic: The screw and washer tighten onto the fixed stub. The washer overlaps the disc bore while remaining axially clear of the rotating disc.
limitations: The 1.6 mm blind floor is nominal remaining material, not a verified load capacity.
Measure the actual stub, disc bore and washer before confirming free rotation.
The retaining screw head and thread engagement are not modeled by this washer check.
A compatible supplier shell is used; it is not certified as the exact owned C018 build.
